title: 878 Small Businesses, One Fake Toner Company, $3.3 Million
one_paragraph_summary: For six years, Mark Mushkin ran a phony company called IT Tech Products that mailed fake invoices to small businesses nationwide — mostly law firms — falsely claiming they'd ordered and received shipments of copier toner, and asking for payment. When a business questioned an invoice, Mushkin would simply refund them to avoid scrutiny while continuing the scheme against everyone else. Federal prosecutors say he deposited 1,919 checks totaling more than $3.3 million from 878 different small businesses before he was charged with mail fraud.
named_parties: Mark Timothy Mushkin; IT Tech Products
why_it_hooks: If you complained, he refunded you immediately — the perfect trick to keep scamming everyone who didn't.
